description:
EnergyIQ product content for building energy monitoring - the boards, queries,
stream-data archives and rollups every EnergyIQ tenant shares (AB#7996).

Installs:
- the EnergyIQ construction kit model with Basic and Basic.Energy (auto-imported
  from the catalog)
- 19 RawArchives, one per measured EnergyIQ type (room sensors, light, shading,
  meters, grid, wallboxes, appliances, PV, battery, heat pump, storage, pump),
  including the computed grid/battery columns ImportPower/ExportPower/
  ChargePower/DischargePower the Energiebilanz board integrates
- 14 RollupArchives (5-minute AVG/MIN/MAX, 1-hour grid rollup) the
  resolution-aware line charts and the heatmaps need
- 5 MeshBoards (Raumtemperaturen, Energie, Energiebilanz, Heizung & Kuehlung,
  Beschattung & Beleuchtung) with 41 widgets and 42 persistent queries; every
  board picks its site through the "Standort" selector
- the process diagram "Energiefluss live" (grid, PV, battery, wallbox, devices) of
  the Energie board (AB#7941)
- the _trees query and the Runtime Browser tree navigation (role labels,
  "Systems" perspective on DistributionSystem)

NOT included - this stays tenant data, imported or maintained per tenant:
sites and their digital twin (Site/Building/rooms/devices, data/bim/*), site
price and CO2 values, adapters and deployment sites, Loxone/MQTT/AI
configurations, secrets, and pipelines (no pipeline in this version; every
current one is bound to a site).

PREREQUISITES: communication and stream data enabled on the tenant
(octo-cli -c EnableCommunication, octo-cli -c EnableStreamData).

Post-install (manual until AB#7991 activates archives automatically):
- Activate every archive once - the RawArchives first, then the RollupArchives:
    octo-cli -c ActivateArchive -id <rtId>
  The rtIds are listed in seed-data/archives/rt-archives-energyiq.yaml and
  seed-data/ui/rt-meshboards-energyiq.yaml (and in scripts/om_importrt.ps1).
  Re-applying the blueprint keeps an activated archive activated
  (Archive.Status is runtime state).
- Optional: backfill a new rollup from existing raw data:
    octo-cli -c BackfillRollup -id <rollupRtId>
- Import a site (e.g. data/bim/rt-firmianstrasse.yaml) - without a site the
  boards show their empty state.

Rule for archive changes: a change to an existing archive's columns or to an
existing RollupArchive definition (bucket, aggregations, sources) is NOT
shipped through a blueprint update until AB#7992/AB#7993 (rollups) and
AB#7997/AB#8002 (columns on an active archive) are done - such a change is a
new archive with a new rtId instead. See README "EnergyIQ.Base blueprint".
